summary: Iter 89 — End-to-end testing of BRONZE/SILVER/GOLD subscriptions. 22/22 backend pytest pass. All critical UI flows verified: landing #prezzi + /prezzi with Mensile/Annuale toggle (BRONZE annuale = €15,20/mese, €182,40 addebitati ogni anno), comparison table OK at 390px (no horizontal overflow), test_saas2 (trial) shows trial-chip 'Prova GOLD · Ti restano 14 giorni' + 'Scopri i piani' CTA → /profilo?tab=abbonamento, MySubscription tab shows plan picker (BRONZE/SILVER/GOLD cards) and 'Videochiamate utilizzate: 0 di 3' usage line, mobile 390 shows trial-banner-mobile + trial-cta-mobile + profile-button, Assistenza page in plan mode shows 'Videochiamate utilizzate: 0 di 3 (prova)' and no credit cost, test_saas1 (GOLD paid) shows GOLD Attivo + Mensile + €79/mese + storico pagamenti + Cambia piano/Gestisci abbonamento/Annulla abbonamento buttons + NO trial chip, SA /piattaforma/abbonamenti renders 3 tabs (Organizzazioni / Piani e prezzi / Migrazione crediti). Backend verified: /saas/plans-public (no auth) returns correct 3 plans with exact prices/features/quotas; registration creates GOLD trial 14 days with video quota 3 trial period and no signup bonus; BRONZE plan gating → /companies 403 plan_feature, /events 200; SILVER → /companies 200, /deals + /lodgings 403 plan_feature; trial expired + no plan → GET 200 but POST /events 403 plan_readonly; /saas/me & /account/billing still accessible when readonly; test_saas1 Stripe TEST flows: change-preview, downgrade schedules pending_change, cancel-pending works, cancel toggles cancel_at_period_end then resume restores it; checkout returns 400 billing_missing when billing not configured; SA platform endpoints OK (orgs list, config version increments + history, migration-report); non-superadmin → 403; cron POST without Bearer → 401, with secret → 200 accepted; legacy qa.eventi org has saas.enabled=false, no plan gating, credits still accessible; events in subscription org have credit_state='attivo'; video quota: info shows plan+trial+quota=3 for test_saas2, pre-filling used=3 then booking returns 403 code=video_quota and info shows allowed=false, BRONZE org info shows allowed=false + support=email, test_saas1 GOLD shows unlimited=true + priority=true. Minor UI observation: on test_saas1 MySubscription summary, 'Scadenza prova' column displays '01/01/2020' (stale/past date) — spec says the trial section/row should be hidden when purchased=true; present but ignorable value. No critical bugs found. Cleanup OK: all TEST_ orgs/users/events/quotas created during the run are deleted by test_zz_cleanup.

design_issues.screen: Profilo & Account → Il mio abbonamento (GOLD paid user, test_saas1)
issues: Column 'SCADENZA PROVA' shows '01/01/2020' for a user whose trial has long since converted — misleading. Either hide the field when purchased=true (as spec says 'hidden when purchased') or omit the row from the paid summary. The chip hiding logic in header is correct; only the inline summary row leaks the stale date.

action_items: (Minor UI) In MySubscription summary (/profilo?tab=abbonamento) hide 'Scadenza prova' row/field when saas.purchased is true — currently shows an unrelated past date (01/01/2020) for test_saas1 (GOLD paid).
critical_code_review_comments: subscriptions.py:214 — _enforce_plan uses route tpl path (strips /api) and calls P.route_rule(tpl, method). Make sure new feature-only sub-routes (hospitality lodgings/meals, sponsor deals) remain mapped in permissions.ROUTE_RULES or they would silently become unrestricted. Current test shows they are correctly gated for BRONZE/SILVER.

subscriptions.py:607-626 — video_consume uses find_one_and_update with filter {used:$lt:quota}; the collection has a unique index on (org_id, period) so concurrent requests racing past the limit will fail with DuplicateKeyError (handled) OR return None (quota exceeded). Good atomic design.

subscriptions.py:328-335 — plan_changed email triggered on upgrade/downgrade via sync_sub works, but the idempotency key uses current_period_start (cps) — if Stripe sends a sub.updated with same cps twice this will dedupe correctly; good.
subscriptions.py:467 — checkout stores session; good — but there is no TTL/cleanup for saas_checkouts collection. Consider a TTL index on created_at (e.g. 7 days) to avoid unbounded growth.

server.py:1420 — new events in subscription orgs get credit_state='attivo' (verified in test). The default fallback credit_state='preparazione' is set at line 1421 only if not already set; chain order is correct.

server.py:239 — _enforce_plan is called AFTER _enforce_perm, so a collaborator will first fail on permissions if they lack them, and the plan check applies after. For an admin_org on a BRONZE plan, the plan check correctly triggers plan_feature 403 on /companies — verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all key UI flows verified across desktop 1920 and mobile 390

seed_data_creation: Created 4 TEST_ orgs via /auth/register-organization during testing (TEST_RegTrial_, TEST_Bronze_, TEST_RO_, TEST_VBronze_). All of them (plus their users, memberships, events, saas_video_quota, saas_emails, credit_ledger) are deleted at the end of the run by test_zz_cleanup. test_saas1 Stripe subscription was briefly toggled (downgrade→cancel-pending; cancel→resume) and left in its original state (resumed, not cancelled).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid. The only observed minor UI inconsistency is the stale 'SCADENZA PROVA 01/01/2020' value shown on the paid-user MySubscription summary (test_saas1). Spec says trial elements should be hidden once purchased=true — the trial-chip in header already follows this correctly; only the summary row needs the same gating. All test_saas1 Stripe TEST operations are safe and reversible — downgrade creates a pending_change which test cleans up with cancel-pending, cancel/resume is also toggled back. The pytest file test_iter89_subscriptions.py is self-contained (uses pymongo sync for state manipulation, requests for HTTP) and can be re-run as regression; it writes JUnit to /app/test_reports/pytest/iter89.xml.
rca of the issue: N/A — no backend or integration bugs found. Minor UI issue (stale 'Scadenza prova' shown for paid users on MySubscription summary) is a presentation-only concern: the backend state.trial_end is still populated with the original trial end date (even after conversion) because trial_end is never cleared on upgrade — this is actually correct for audit purposes. The frontend should conditionally hide trial_end when saas.purchased is true. File to fix: /app/frontend/src/components/MySubscription.jsx (hide the 'Scadenza prova' field when purchased).
